units.implementationStatus: Partial: merged PR2 supplies pinned managed intake service verification with explicit local non-owner identity mapping; it does not authenticate end users. PR3 snapshots trusted mappings and bounds credential/transport/body verification with cancellation, finite byte/chunk budgets, strict JSON UTF8 and sanitized failures. End-user federation, member provisioning and live host integration remain pending.

units.acceptanceCriteria: Verify normal behavior and rejection paths with source-bound automated evidence. Live acceptance is separate.
units.implementationStatus: Partial: PR4 durable policy/actor epochs and exact capability revocations with fixed host administrator configuration; PR5 five actual disposable PostgreSQL17 restricted-session scenarios passed final-head CI40573372927. PR6 adds Identity-owned dynamic member roles/disable/re-enable, unique permanent actor kinds, stored human-owner admission before cached lookup, last-owner protection and own-principal current-role resolution. Ten new restricted-migration groups, 39 ordinary tests/typecheck/build/registry pass. Three new TCP-session scenarios await actual CI/final-head acceptance. Host authentication/provisioning, integrated current-policy action gateways, synchronization with separate capability revocations/other-engine policies, compartments and production/live qualification remain pending.
